author: Richard Alleman
source_file: New York  the movie lovers guide  the ultimate insider tour of movie New York (Alleman, Richard etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf
extraction_note: Neighborhood-organized movie-location guidebook (revised ed., 2005). Chunked at the natural chapter level: 13 borough/neighborhood chapters, each a numbered walking itinerary of film/TV locations, studios, movie palaces, and star residences with addresses and movie titles+years. Front matter (title, copyright, dedication, Introduction) and back matter (Index, Photo Credits) excluded. PDF extracts cleanly via pdftotext with digits intact (NO Expert/PUA-font issue). A numbered map precedes each chapter; its OCR'd labels appear as scattered short fragments at chapter starts — .cleaned.txt strips sparse map-label runs via scripts/strip_pdf_artifacts.py.
